desc:
🔑 ESCAPE CLUB — first-person escape rooms with friends

Form a party in the hotel lobby, ride the elevator and get locked in. Find clues, crack the locks and escape before time runs out!

🕵️ CASE 01 · The Missing Detective (Mystery · 25 min)
1931. A famous detective has vanished. Search his locked office and expose the culprit.

🚀 CASE 02 · Station Omega (Sci-Fi · 25 min)
2087. The power is out and oxygen is leaking. Restart the reactor and launch the escape pod!

🏥 CASE 03 · Ward 404 (Horror · 30 min)
At midnight, "the nurse" wakes up. Return the girl's treasures and get out alive. ⚠ Jump scares

🧩 Real escape-room puzzles: keys, locks, safe dials, keypads, UV ink, Morse code, lasers, wiring
👥 1–6 players (solo OK) · 💡 Hints anytime
🏆 Faster = better grade · Tokens for trails & titles
📅 New lobby quest every day

E interact · 1–8 items · TAB menu · ALT mouse · H hint
